intent: Give unattended mission dispatch one durable owner across queue and cron ticks, and prevent late gateway acknowledgements or failures from reversing an operator cancellation.
invariants: The spend stop runs before a durable unattended claim and leaves due work unconsumed when armed.
Concurrent queue ticks submit one mission under one idempotency key; a concurrent cron tick cannot bypass the same single-flight decision.
An operator cancellation is final locally; a late gateway success or failure cannot rewrite its mission or run, and any returned backend ID is stopped.
A claim with an uncertain post-restart gateway outcome is held for operator review, never automatically resubmitted with a new key or described as certainly unsubmitted (Q-031).
Existing attended dispatch, schedule occurrence identity and advancement, elapsed deadlines and five-minute reconciliation grace remain intact.
rollback: Restore the earlier dispatch path only with another durable reservation and conditional acknowledgement that passes the same real-database concurrent oracle; never silently restore duplicate unattended submissions or cancellation reversal.
verify_line: With an isolated SQLite database and held fake gateway, overlapping queue ticks and a due cron tick cannot create two unattended submissions; cancelling before either a successful or failed acknowledgement keeps cancellation final and stops any returned backend ID; the existing elapsed-deadline and grace suites retain their names and results.
claim_expansion: The approved register named queue tick, orchestration dispatch and cancel handler. Read-only independent review found the reservation belongs in mission/run repositories, a competing cron tick uses a separate claim, and run reconciliation can overwrite newer cancellation. These additional paths are claimed to preserve the approved single-flight and cancellation invariants, without a schema or protected-set edit.
approval: The operator approved Phase 2 prerelease T-0180–T-0187 on 2026-09-28 and answered Q-031 on 2026-09-28: hold uncertain post-restart submissions for operator review with no automatic replay.
